canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Envoy Mortgage, Ltd denied {value} of its 2,264 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Envoy Mortgage, Ltd decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Envoy Mortgage, Ltd will deny any specific future application with 42.0% probability
Envoy Mortgage, Ltd is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Envoy Mortgage, Ltd discriminates or violates law
42.0% applies to Envoy Mortgage, Ltd's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
